admission.justification: Custody, preview bounds and legacy admission together promise one exact archive no single check promises alone.

guarantee: A sprint archive attempt is admitted only against terminal rows and ready masters, refuses a same-request retry with missing custody or changed archived bytes, stays bounded and exact in preview at any master count, and restores every moved folder before reporting when a resumed move fails; no phase reports completion it did not earn.
title: A sprint archive is admitted, bounded and custodial as one operation
